businessCase.title:
Make the economics part
of the monthly conversation.
businessCase.description: Explore a scenario before you speak to us. This is a transparent calculation, not a forecast or a promised result.
notes: Contribution = net revenue × contribution margin − media spend. Scenario revenue = current revenue × (1 + change). MER = net revenue ÷ media spend. Agency fees, fixed overhead, tax and changes in cost structure are excluded. This is not profit, ROI, causal lift or a benchmark.
Calculations stay in this page. No account required.
Media spend and margin rate stay fixed in this scenario. Changing currency relabels amounts; no exchange conversion.

faq.title:
Good questions.
Clear answers.
faq.description:
Short answers to what enterprise teams usually
ask before a first call.

items.q: Is this for B2B or consumer brands?
items.a: Both. We work with brands that sell to consumers and with companies that sell to other businesses. Our four industry playbooks cover e-commerce, subscriptions and apps, education, and multi-location operators. For B2B companies, we also look at sales cycles, qualified pipeline and CRM revenue.

items.q: Do we need all four channels?
items.a: No. We start with the channels where your evidence is strongest and add the others only when a test shows they earn their place. Many mandates begin with two.

items.q: Can we see the evidence before making a commitment?
items.a: Yes. The Growth Diagnostic is a fixed-fee, six-week assessment. You get the account audit, the measurement review and a prioritised roadmap before deciding on a longer mandate.

items.q: Who owns the accounts and reporting?
items.a: You do. Ad accounts, tracking and dashboards sit in your organisation from day one, and we work inside them. If we part ways, everything stays with you.
